name: skyrim-vr-automation
description: Codex skills for transactional Skyrim VR automation, local feedback, DevBench profiling, and reusable shader-cache management.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Skyrim VR test and profiling controls.

Run a bounded Skyrim VR test session through MO2.
